name: Magic In Movies
overview: Scripture clearly condemns all forms of witchcraft, enchantment, divination, and seeking after familiar spirits, warning believers to avoid these practices entirely. God commands His people not to tolerate witches or wizards and promises judgment against those who turn to such occult activities. The Bible emphasizes that engaging in magic or sorcery defiles the believer and breaks fellowship with God, underscoring the need for Christians to reject any involvement with magical arts as depicted in movies or elsewhere.
